subject: Request: SOC 2 auth evidence & bridge letter — PrimeHealth
messages:
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@primehealth.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@auditfirm.com>, security@primehealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:03:00 -0400
Subject: SOC 2 Type II - Request for AuthN/AuthZ evidence + bridge scope clarification

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the SOC 2 Type II report. Our audit team (Marta copied) needs a few targeted artifacts beyond the report so we can close a scoped control for PrimeHealth's assessment. Can you confirm the planned delivery and scope for the following items?

1) MFA configuration snapshot and enforcement policy (how MFA is enforced for all accounts, where exceptions exist and how they're approved).
2) Auth logs: a time-sliced extract covering the audit window (2027-03-01 to 2027-04-30) showing successful/failed interactive logins and token refresh events. We understand PII may need redaction; a UUID mapping is fine.
3) Access review evidence: the most recent quarterly access review report for privileged roles and any manual remediation tickets from that review.
4) Key/keystore rotation records (dates, owners) for production signing keys used in token issuance.
5) A bridge letter that explicitly states whether any relevant control changes occurred after the SOC 2 Type II testing period and whether any compensating controls are in place.

Timing: the auditor is hoping to receive these artifacts within two business weeks to avoid delaying certification timelines. Please let us know what you can provide and any constraints (redaction, export formats).

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Alvarez
InfoSec Program Manager
PrimeHealth

Tom / Marta — thanks for the patience. Please find our initial package and notes below. We can add more detail once we confirm your redaction/NDAs.

Delivered artifacts (Drive folder link above):
- redwood-soc2-bridge-letter-draft.docx (attached) — draft bridge letter confirming that the SOC 2 testing period covered 2026-06-01 to 2027-02-28 and listing the controls evaluated. It also states no substantive control changes affecting authentication occurred through 2027-04-30; where procedural changes were made we document compensating controls.
- auth-log-sample-202703-202704.csv (attached stub) — time-sliced extract covering 2027-03-01 -> 2027-04-30. Columns: timestamp, user_id (hashed UUID), event_type, result, region. - access-review-2027Q1.pdf (in folder) — export of the quarterly access review with a supplemental sheet listing remediation ticket ids and closure dates.

- Audit window: SOC 2 Type II testing covered through 2027-02-28. We are providing the log slice 2027-03-01 -> 2027-04-30 proactively to show continuity; the bridge letter calls out that no relevant control regressions occurred in that slice.
- Redaction: PII (emails, IPs) were redacted and replaced with hashed identifiers. We documented the redaction approach in README.txt inside the Drive folder.
- Format & delivery: CSV/JSON exports; happy to provide a SFTP or secure transfer if you prefer.
- Next steps: Marta, if the auditor needs the reversible mapping for a small number of accounts as part of an investigation, please advise the scope and we will prepare a minimal mapping under a bilateral NDA.

Please confirm receipt and whether the auditor has any follow-ups. If everything looks ok we'll mark this as delivered and schedule a short call to walk through the artifacts.

Best,
